userPriority: Reduce verification time as part of total active work time, with mandatory fidelity preserved.
captureOnceGradeMany: Freeze one actual output occurrence and let all applicable graders read it. The shared runSuite can otherwise rerun a target per evaluator; use the existing captured-artifact path instead of repeated native executions. Native runtime remains the execution owner.

stages.checks: PDF identity, page/question mapping and original source extraction.
stages.reuse: Reuse against the exact source hash; never OCR the entire paper for an isolated local edit.

stages.checks: Validate changed structured nodes, their transitive dependencies and affected previews.
stages.reuse: Use unchanged, qualified results; preserve their source and checker versions.

stages.checks: One targeted original/restored crop review, with sufficient context to avoid misleading crops.
stages.reuse: Request a strong model or human judgment only for the unresolved fact; confidence alone never certifies correctness.

stages.checks: Run the relevant regression cases; invalidate every dependent result.
stages.reuse: Do not rerun the whole adversarial suite after an unrelated text edit.

stages.at: Before HWPX and after its eventual creation
stages.checks: Before export, aggregate all 24 problem statuses and source coverage. Later perform the separate native HWPX equation/layout/package/PDF check once per exact final artifact.
stages.reuse: Pre-export success does not establish native HWPX behavior. Rerun changed artifact checks after any final serialization change.

exampleDependencyRules.condition: The dependency graph proves coordinates and semantic point identity unchanged.

rerun: Affected geometric construction and dependent points
retain: Unrelated question outputs and unchanged source text

exampleDependencyRules.change: Shared font, math renderer or page template
rerun: All affected previews/layout regressions and final coverage
retain: Only checks proven independent of that shared dependency

cacheKey: Exact structured object and dependency hashes
Renderer, fonts, viewport and layout versions
Applicable scope, original decisions and current source qualification
reuseRule: Reuse only a passing result whose complete key and dependency closure remain current. A changed rubric, truth, source, prompt, font, scope or dependency invalidates the affected result. Unknowns remain unknown.
boundedReview: Use one independent finding list and one local repair cycle first. Re-evaluate repaired findings plus affected regressions; stop for a specific unresolved fact instead of opening unbounded verification rounds.

timing.target: Demonstrate lower measured total time without critical misses; no unmeasured percentage saving claimed.
timing.setupCost: Report verifier setup/evaluation overhead separately and include it in the first-paper total.

nativeOwnership: Native Codex retains tools, dispatch, sessions and cancellation. This file is a policy proposal, not an executor, enrollment or paid permit.
